articles.summary: CINCINNATI – Executives from The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) will discuss the company’s business strategies at three investor conferences in November and December.
articles.title: Scripps to present on business strategies at three upcoming investor conferences

articles.summary: CINCINNATI – The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) has promoted Christina Hartman to chief technology officer, effective immediately. Hartman will lead Scripps’ long-term technology strategy as the company builds a technology-powered media organization designed to connect Scripps and its brands with today’s consumers.
articles.title: Scripps appoints new chief technology officer

articles.summary: CINCINNATI – The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) delivered $545 million in revenue for the third quarter of 2026. Income attributable to the shareholders of Scripps was $20.7 million or 21 cents per share.
articles.title: Scripps reports Q3 2026 financial results
